items.headline: Open Championship Dates
items.text: The 2026 Open Championship will be held July 16-19 at Royal Birkdale, as the final major of the season.

items.headline: Open Field Confirmed
items.text: The field for the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale has been confirmed, setting the stage for the year's last major.
